title: AERIFY: fewer events than expected
endpoint: Annualized rate of acute moderate or severe COPD exacerbations
source_summary: User-provided message.txt narrative; historical outcome and power statements checked against the sponsor release, not a raw registry export.

trials.name: AERIFY-1
trials.reported_outcome: Met the primary endpoint at 52 weeks.

trials.name: AERIFY-2
trials.reported_outcome: Did not meet the primary endpoint at 52 weeks.

report.label: Regeneron and Sanofi results announcement — May 30, 2025
report.summary: The sponsors reported fewer exacerbations than anticipated and reduced statistical power in both trials. Pandemic-era enrollment was described as a possible contributor, not an established cause.

limitations: This historical context does not establish why AERIFY-2 missed its endpoint. Recurrent exacerbation rates cannot be entered as binary risks without an explicit validated model. Original binary planning assumptions and reconstructed trial power are not available here.
illustrative_disclosure: The default sample data are synthetic binary assumptions, not AERIFY measurements or a reconstruction. A planned control risk of 20% falls to 10% with RR 0.75 and zero dropout; enrollment stays at 903 per arm and approximate conditional power falls from 80% to 47%. Power is the chance of detecting the assumed difference under the model, not the probability a drug works.
